v: This Calgary street is named after an oil city in China.
In Chinatown, Second Avenue Southwest has a second name: Daqing.
It was named in nineteen eighty-five, for Calgary's twin city in China.
Daqing is one of China's most important sources of oil.
There's even a Daqing Plaza, at the Chinese Cultural Centre's west entrance.
